title.narrative: Resilient Research: Assessing Baseline Gaps for Scientific Practice in EA

description.narrative:
This joint project to be co-delivered with OP5.3.SHS and evaluates the institutional baselines and safety frameworks required to protect scientists and scientific data during environmental disruptions in East Asia. The initiative aims to identify critical vulnerabilities within regional research ecosystems, with a specific focus on safeguarding women field researchers.
Key activities include conducting desk-based surveys across regional university networks, auditing remote database accessibility, and running targeted consultation sessions during scheduled network meetings. The primary expected outcome is a comprehensive sub-regional gap analysis that establishes validated policy priorities and baseline criteria. This evidence base will directly guide future national scientific regulations and form the foundation for scaling up long-term research resilience initiatives.
